content.title: Recommendation on early discharge for low-risk PE

recommendations.text: Carefully selected patients with low-risk PE should be considered for early discharge and continuation of treatment at home, if proper outpatient care and anticoagulant treatment can be provided.
recommendations.footnote_text: See section 7 and Figure 6 for further guidance on defining low-risk PE and decision-making.
